items: You have one decision to make: should these changes to 5 files go in? Until you answer, they stay out. What happened: only the Investors may edit these files, so at 11:35 ET, at the end of a work session, the company's automatic file check put them back the way they were. Work sessions made these changes (Operator, describing them as "Revert proposal #226 (applied on approve in f0f6db6885; it broke a test)"; "Revert proposal #225 (applied on approve in 8d5131b89b; it broke a test)"). There is no Approve button here, because this change can't be written from the site. If you want it, edit the file on GitHub yourself. Disapprove keeps all 5 files as they are now and records your answer. We recommend Disapprove unless you asked for this change, because work sessions may not edit these files.
Approve or Disapprove on Home > Issues, with your token saved.
